step1_analysis.description: A passive RLC network, likely an input, interstage, or output matching network for a W-band power amplifier. It provides impedance matching and DC biasing (via label_net_0 and label_net_1) while passing the RF signal through a series-shunt LC bandpass topology.

paper_reference.title: A 20-dB Gain W-band InP DHBT Power Amplifier

center_frequency.description: The frequency at which the matching network has minimum insertion loss.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by LC values. For L=100pH, C=100fF, f = 1/(2*pi*sqrt(LC)) ~= 50 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends entirely on the chosen passive component values in the testbench since no active devices are present.

insertion_loss.description: The loss of the signal as it passes through the matching network at the center frequency.

paper_reported.value: Low loss (exact value not specified for the passive network alone)

sky130_expected.calculation: Simulated S21 magnitude at center frequency.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Passive networks always have some insertion loss; a good matching network should have > -3dB.

bandwidth.description: The 3-dB bandwidth of the matching network.

sky130_expected.calculation: Difference between upper and lower 3dB cutoff frequencies.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Broadband matching networks typically cover 10-20% fractional bandwidth.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure the frequency response, insertion loss, and bandwidth of the passive matching network.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Passive Matching Network Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param L1_val=100p C3_val=100f R1_val=10 L2_val=100p C2_val=100f C1_val=100f R2_val=10

* Ground definition for compatibility
V_gnd GND 0 0

* DUT
C1 n1 GND {C1_val}
L1 n0 label_net_0 {L1_val}
C2 n1 n3 {C2_val}
R1 n0 n2 {R1_val}
R2 n1 label_net_1 {R2_val}
C3 n0 GND {C3_val}
L2 n2 n3 {L2_val}

* Sources and Terminations (50 ohm system)
V_in label_net_0_src 0 dc 0.9 ac 2
R_S label_net_0_src label_net_0 50
V_out label_net_1_src 0 dc 0.9
R_L label_net_1 label_net_1_src 50

.control
ac dec 100 1G 200G
let v_out_db = vdb(label_net_1)

* Measure peak gain (minimum insertion loss)
meas ac peak_gain max v_out_db

* Measure bandwidth (using a fixed threshold for robust ngspice compatibility)
meas ac f_low when v_out_db=-10 rise=1
meas ac f_high when v_out_db=-10 fall=1

print peak_gain f_low f_high
quit
.endc
.end
